summary: hardhat-devkit ships a 4.5MB obfuscated payload that executes on require
details: The package presents itself as 'hardhat-devkit' but its README and lib/ layout are copied from pino, and its visible middleware export is an inert stub that only calls next(). The package's index.js (main) immediately requires./lib/config, a 4,499,968-byte single-line obfuscator.io-style blob (hex-encoded string array, array rotator using while(!![]) with push/shift, and layered indirection functions). This heavy obfuscation is applied to code that runs on every require()/import of the package, so any process that loads 'hardhat-devkit' executes the hidden payload. The name/README/code mismatch (hardhat-devkit identity, pino README, author Robert King <hello@jsonspack.com> with bugs URL at jsonspack.com) is a deliberate impersonation shape wrapped around a load-time loader for opaque code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
